prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit Indian palace courtyard of pale sandstone with carved arches of standard height, low steps and a waist-high jali screen, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Ukrainian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair, luminous skin, round warm red blush high on the cheeks, dark strongly defined straight brows, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large blue-grey eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural deep rose lip, and a wreath of real red poppies, blue cornflowers and wheat ears sitting on top of the head, a warm, calm expression, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in long thick box braids, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long bronze chain ending in one large faceted diamond drop, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a lead cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten mixed-metal hair ornaments. Extremely long coffin nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her body carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL scale formations, VIVID SILVER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme white platform stiletto ankle boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Hawaiian man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, light smoky eyeliner and glossy skin, smooth warm bronze skin, a warm natural smile, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying one heavy rough hammered matte metal weight on copper chain (a gold square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a lead pyramid-shaped lump, a tin hammer head, a bronze barrel-shaped weight, a bronze miniature anvil, a gold chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered silver rings. Extremely long stiletto nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: A thick, heavy, extremely strong man built like a powerlifter. A huge barrel chest, enormously wide shoulders and back, a thick solid waist with a firm rounded belly over strong abs, massive arms, and enormous thick thighs and calves. Every part is large, dense and continuous rather than sharply cut. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His body carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, temple bell dragon formations in DEEP BRONZE and GOLD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. It is fused to his own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: both hands sweeping his hair back.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme tan-brown high-top platform sneakers with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
